environment.description: Terraform provider gRPC service deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet with an internet-facing NLB. Security group allows inbound on port 8443 from 0.0.0.0/0. DNS record provider-api.company.io resolves to the NLB's public IP. No VPC endpoint policy or network restrictions on outbound DNS resolution. The instance has outbound internet access via NAT gateway for the backend connection attempt.
